THE EASTERN WAR 2.5
A war without end. A battlefield without limits.

Enter a persistent military conflict where strategy, teamwork, and skill determine victory. Fight across 
multiple realistic battlefields, choose your faction, and experience immersive military combat like never before.

• Realistic military & tactical FPS gameplay
• 6 unique maps with different combat scenarios
• Open-world battlefields with active warzones
• Ground and Vehicle combat
• Roleplay-friendly environment
• Optimized for PC, Console & Mobile (Mobile WIP)
• Frequent updates and new content
